Name: MoreProfitMargins
Author: Ytloe
Description:
1.0.0
在高级选项的利润率下拉菜单中添加更多选项
Add a 0% option to the profit margin dropdown menu in the advanced settings

阻止由于利润过低导致皮埃尔被玩家零元购的错误，现在皮埃尔出售种子的底价为1块钱
Fix the bug where players could purchase Pierre's seeds for free due to excessively low profits. Now, Pierre's seed selling price has a minimum floor of 1 gold

1.1.0
修复了沙漠商人等以物易物的商店会额外多出1块钱手续费的bug
Fixed a bug where bartering shops (like the Desert Trader) would charge an extra 1 gold coin as a fee

添加了更多利率选项：0%，1%，150%，200%，1000%
Added more profit margin options: 0%, 1%, 150%, 200%, 1000%

修改nexus上的mod名称：
0_Profit_margins → MoreProfitMargins

Manifest.Name: MoreProfitMargins
Manifest.Description: 为游戏添加更多利率选项，在需要金钱交易时，设置底价为1g避免零元购和额外手续费
Manifest.Author: Ytloe
